3.4.2.6-f92.text: Vis a dubio liberari? Vis quod incertum est evadere? Age poenitentiam dum sanus es; sic agens, dico tibi quod securus es, quod poenitentiam egisti eo tempore quo peccare potuisti

translations.literal: Do you wish to be freed from doubt? Do you wish to escape what is uncertain? Do penance while you are healthy; so doing, I say to you that you are secure, because you did penance at that time in which you could sin.
translations.note: The passage is from a sermon on penitents transmitted among Augustine's works. Its point is that repentance made while one is still healthy and able to sin is sure, unlike repentance put off until the deathbed.
translations.text: Do you wish to be freed from doubt? Do you wish to escape what is uncertain? Repent while you are in health; doing so, I tell you that you are safe, because you repented at a time when you were still able to sin.
